---
name: Spike specifications
description: Rules for specifications, ADRs, results and traceability documents
applyTo: "specs/**"
---

# Specification rules

- Treat accepted specifications as versioned contracts.
- Preserve stable requirement identifiers.
- Do not change a Must requirement without recording the decision.
- Every requirement must have measurable acceptance criteria.
- Link requirements to implementation, tests and pull requests.
- Distinguish observations, hypotheses, decisions and unresolved risks.
- Use Draft, Implemented, Verified, Failed or Deferred as requirement states.
- Mark a requirement as Verified only after its automated test passes.
